body.name: \(R\)
body.construction: For each non-tree edge \(e=(g,t)\), \(g<\infty\), \(2\le t<g\), let \(r_e\) have entries \(+1/\mu_{g1},-1/\mu_{gt},-1/\mu_{\infty1},+1/\mu_{\infty t}\) on \((g,1),(g,t),(\infty,1),(\infty,t)\), respectively, and zero elsewhere; \(R=(r_e:e\in U\setminus\mathcal T_0)\)
